questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of <!DOCTYPE html> at the top of an HTML file?
options: Instruct the browser to render the page in Standards Mode
Import the latest HTML5 standard library from W3C
Automatically set the page encoding to UTF-8
questions.explanation: <!DOCTYPE html> switches browsers into Standards Mode so CSS layout and DOM APIs behave consistently.

questions.prompt: Which script attribute downloads in parallel and executes in document order after HTML parsing finishes?
questions.explanation: defer downloads asynchronously and guarantees ordered execution once the document is parsed.

questions.prompt: How many distinct navigation landmarks with accessible names are exposed by this markup?

codeSnippet.code:
Home
About

questions.explanation: Each <nav> natively maps to role="navigation", and both provide distinct aria-label names.

questions.prompt: Which element should appear only once as the dominant content landmark per HTML document?
questions.explanation: A document must not have more than one visible <main> element.

questions.prompt: Why should you avoid jumping directly from <h1> to <h4> in a page outline?
options: It breaks logical hierarchy for screen readers and assistive navigation
Browsers refuse to render <h4> without an <h3> above it
CSS font-weight stops working on skipped headings
Search engines de-index any page containing an <h4> tag
questions.explanation: Assistive technologies announce heading depth; skipping levels disorients users navigating by headings.

questions.prompt: What numbering sequence does the browser render for this ordered list?
questions.explanation: start="5" begins the counter at 5, and reversed decrements by 1 for each item: 5, 4, 3.

questions.prompt: Which rel value prevents a newly opened tab from manipulating window.opener?
questions.explanation: rel="noopener" sets window.opener to null in the new browsing context, blocking reverse tabnabbing.

questions.prompt: Which HTML element group is specifically designed for key-value metadata or glossary terms?
questions.explanation: <dl> (description list) pairs <dt> (term) with <dd> (description).

questions.prompt: How many data cells are merged horizontally in the second row of this table?
questions.explanation: colspan="2" stretches the single <td> across both the Q1 and Q2 columns.

questions.prompt: Which field values will be included when this form is submitted?

codeSnippet.code:
<form>
  <input name="plan" value="pro" readonly />
  <input name="coupon" value="SAVE10" disabled />
  <input value="anonymous" />
</form>

questions.explanation: readonly fields ARE submitted, disabled fields are excluded, and inputs without a name attribute are ignored.

questions.prompt: What is the default behavior of a <button> inside a <form> when no type attribute is specified?
options: It is disabled until JavaScript attaches a listener
questions.explanation: Per the HTML specification, the missing-value default for <button> type is submit.

questions.prompt: Which input configuration best captures a 6-digit OTP code while preserving leading zeros and showing a mobile number pad?
questions.explanation: type="text" preserves leading zeros and honors maxlength, while inputmode="numeric" triggers the numeric keypad.

questions.prompt: Which image file does a modern browser supporting WebP (but not AVIF) download here?
questions.explanation: The browser skips unsupported image/avif, matches image/webp, and downloads only /hero.webp.

questions.prompt: If an image renders at 400px wide on a 2x pixel-density display, which srcset candidate is the closest optimal match?
questions.explanation: 400 CSS px × 2x DPR = 800 device pixels, matching the 800w source cleanly.

questions.prompt: In a <picture> element with AVIF, WebP, and JPEG options, where must the alt text be placed?
questions.explanation: delegates rendering and accessibility attributes to its required fallback child.

questions.prompt: When the user clicks "Confirm" inside this modal dialog, what is dialog.returnValue?
questions.explanation: Submitting a <form method="dialog"> sets dialog.returnValue to the clicked submit button’s value attribute ("confirm").

questions.prompt: Which boolean attribute makes a <details> element expanded on initial page load?
questions.explanation: The open boolean attribute controls whether a <details> element displays its content.

questions.prompt: Which JavaScript method opens a <dialog> in the browser top layer with a ::backdrop and Escape-to-close?
questions.explanation: showModal() promotes the dialog to the top layer and makes background content inert.

questions.prompt: Will the browser execute JavaScript code placed inside this tag?
options: No—it is ignored by the JS engine as a data block
It runs only in quirks mode
questions.explanation: Browsers only execute JavaScript MIME types (or module/importmap); application/ld+json is treated strictly as inert data.

questions.prompt: What accessible name will a screen reader announce for this button?
questions.explanation: aria-labelledby takes precedence over both aria-label and visible text content.

questions.prompt: What does adding role="button" to a <div> NOT automatically provide?
options: Announcement as a button in the accessibility tree
Compatibility with screen reader role queries
questions.explanation: ARIA only changes accessibility metadata; it never adds tabindex focusability or keyboard event handling.

questions.prompt: Which live-region setting should be used for a non-urgent "Copied to clipboard" toast notification?
questions.explanation: Polite live regions wait for the screen reader to finish speaking before announcing routine status feedback.

questions.prompt: What text renders inside <info-pill></info-pill> given this Declarative Shadow DOM template?
questions.explanation: Because no light-DOM child was supplied, the default <slot> renders its fallback content "Unassigned".

questions.prompt: Which of the following is a VALID Custom Element tag name?
questions.explanation: Custom element names must start with a lowercase ASCII letter and contain at least one hyphen.

questions.prompt: Which attribute on <template> creates a Declarative Shadow Root during HTML parsing without JavaScript?
questions.explanation: <template shadowrootmode="open"> instructs the HTML parser to attach a Shadow Root automatically.

questions.prompt: Which protocol inside <a href="..."> poses an XSS risk even if quotes and angle brackets are escaped?
questions.explanation: javascript: URLs execute arbitrary script when clicked unless filtered to an allowlist of safe schemes (http:, https:, mailto:).

questions.prompt: Why is the crossorigin attribute mandatory on <link rel="preload" as="font">?
options: Without it, the preload cache key mismatches CSS font requests and downloads the font twice
Browsers refuse to parse WOFF2 files without crossorigin
It automatically compresses the font with Brotli
It prevents third-party sites from hotlinking the font
questions.explanation: Font fetches always use anonymous CORS mode, so matching crossorigin prevents duplicate downloads.

questions.prompt: What does the browser do if a third-party stylesheet fails its integrity="sha384-..." verification?
options: Blocks the stylesheet from being applied
Applies the stylesheet anyway with a console warning
Falls back to HTTP without TLS
Prompts the user with a confirmation dialog
questions.explanation: SRI enforces fail-closed security: tampered resources are rejected completely.

questions.prompt: What does el.dataset.courseLevel return for this element?
questions.explanation: HTML data-course-level maps automatically to element.dataset.courseLevel.
